cd ~/.openclaw/workspace && for repo in ./projects/OpenClawInstall ./projects/SmartHome ./projects/ReachyMini ./skills/puppeteer-browser ./skills/skill-audit ./skills/web-security ./docs/OpenCodeGuide ./docs/WebSecurityGuide ./docs/MakeSkillGuide ./docs/OpenClawGuide; do
  if [ -d "$repo/.git" ]; then
    cd "$repo"
    status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$status" ]; then
      echo "=== $repo ==="
      echo "$status"
      echo ""
    fi
    cd ~/.openclaw/workspace
  fi
done
